S2 — Outcome: add name filtering and pagination to the existing user list endpoint with tests; facts about exact parameter names, matching, pagination, validation, and response conventions remain for discovery, with the defaults recorded in Q1–Q5. Risks include breaking existing clients or changing list order or data visibility, so the default preserves the existing contract for requests without new parameters. The outcome must be usable through the existing user list endpoint and verifiable by the project's tests; in an isolated run, the source checkout remains at its snapshot until final return, when the changes become visible there.
